title: Require explicit recovery selection and preserve its actual outcome
statement: The Command handling Module shall distinguish ordinary interruption inspection from explicitly selected maintenance recovery and preserve actual outcome limits.

what.problem: A command could silently replay uncertain work or choose a replacement state when only inspection was requested.
what.desired_outcome: Ordinary inspection establishes current state; only explicit maintenance resume can finish or permissibly roll back a staged replacement.

why.rationale: SR-045 separates ordinary storage recovery from actor-authorized store replacement and requires truthful outcome limits at the public boundary.

stakeholders: Actors choosing how to resolve interrupted work
Consumers of command and recovery results

conditions: An ordinary command follows interruption, or a caller explicitly requests supported maintenance resume.

contexts: IF-004 query/task admission and reporting using IF-003 inspect_records or the selected maintenance operation.

how.approach: Apply the current v4 SQLite task and maintenance contract. Admit a normal scoped inspection after an interrupted ordinary update; no public record-transaction completion/restore command is exposed.

how_much.scope: This allocation preserves its existing parent SR and accountable Module. Prior v3 file-journal mechanisms are historical at 39be9c81; current maintenance remains separately explicit.

acceptance_criteria: Admit a normal scoped inspection after an interrupted ordinary update; no public record-transaction completion/restore command is exposed.
Ordinary reads may trigger internal SQLite recovery but never choose a new engineering effect, import history or activate a replacement.
Preserve the supplied project/Change selection and report actual established state; do not replay the failed task or refresh stale writes.
Report truthful committed/prior/unknown standing through the command result without converting storage outcome into approval.
Maintenance finish or rollback requires an explicit supported task, operation identity and fresh recovery observation; no automatic resubmission or legacy handler.
constraints: Current v4 SQLite realization; source observations do not establish engineering approval or passing implementation proof.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-045 for the proposed MOD-010 responsibility. Allocates the command-side portion of SR-045, especially criterion 5 and explicit action/reporting across criteria 1 through 4. MOD-011 remains the sole owner of FUNC-047 and actual transaction recovery through AR-022. These criteria specify intended observations, not executed product evidence or an adoption of the REM authoring format by the CLI.
